claims.subject: Howmet Aerospace
claims.source_quote: On December 22, 2025, the Company entered into an agreement with Stanley Black & Decker, Inc. to acquire Consolidated Aerospace Manufacturing, LLC (CAM), a wholly owned subsidiary of Stanley Black & Decker, for a cash purchase price of approximately $1.8 billion ... On February 6, 2026, the Company acquired Brunner Manufacturing Co. Inc., a small privately-held manufacturer of high-quality fastener products located in the U.S., for an all-cash purchase price.
claims.claim_text: HWM announced Proposed CAM Acquisition (~$1.8B from Stanley Black & Decker, Dec 22 2025) and completed Brunner Manufacturing acquisition (~$120M, Feb 6 2026), both rolling into Fastening Systems segment.

queries.rationale: Mode A: confirm 8-K filings disclosed the CAM and Brunner acquisitions

args.parent_thesis: Howmet Aerospace is consolidating its aerospace fastening business by acquiring CAM and Brunner to scale Fastening Systems segment.

queries.rationale: Mode B: aggregate coherence of the two-deal rollup against parent thesis

claims.subject: Howmet Aerospace
claims.object_value: Boeing 737 MAX production rate impacts; FAA approval October 2025
claims.source_quote: quality control issues at The Boeing Company (Boeing) relating to which the Federal Aviation Administration did not approve production rate increases for the Boeing 737 MAX until October 2025 and a Boeing labor union work stoppage in late 2024 negatively impacted narrow body and wide body production rates. Boeing production rates have had and are expected to have a material impact on the financial performance of Howmet.
claims.claim_text: HWM materially exposed to Boeing 737 MAX production rate; affirms Boeing rates have material impact on Howmet financials.

queries.rationale: Mode A: confirm Boeing's filings reference Howmet (named supplier)
Mode B: full-name variant in Boeing disclosures
